summary: Tested SAFe Budget Participatif refonte: 17/17 backend tests PASS (features candidates, PI features, assign/unassign, PB SAFe session creation + cutline greedy retention + decision applying scope_status sec/etendu, manual mode non-regression). Frontend /pb SAFe modal WORKS PERFECTLY (mode toggle, train/PI selects, features preview showing 4 features / 2 056 250 €, use-total btn filling envelope, manual toggle). CRITICAL: /safe/trains page is completely broken by a ReferenceError: 'FeaturesModal is not defined' — component is JSX-rendered at line 650 but never defined nor imported. This blocks entire Vue d'ensemble section and 'Gérer les features' modal.

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: FeaturesModal is not defined — used at line 650-655 but component is neither defined in file nor imported. Page /safe/trains crashes on render (React error overlay). Blocks: PIPanel expansion, pi-feature-row-* rendering, manage-features-btn-* interactions, features-modal-body, features-modal-close. All /trains features from user story #11 are untestable due to this crash.

action_items: URGENT: Define and/or import FeaturesModal component in /app/frontend/src/pages/TrainsSafe.jsx. It should render a modal with data-testid='features-modal-body', 2 groups (Dans ce PI / Disponibles) using safeAPI.featureCandidates + safeAPI.assignFeaturePI, and a close button with data-testid='features-modal-close'. After fix, /safe/trains page needs re-testing for pi-feature-row-*, manage-features-btn-*, feature groups toggling and panel refresh.
critical_code_review_comments: TrainsSafe.jsx uses <FeaturesModal .../> but component is missing — this is a hard runtime crash on any /safe/trains route load.
TrainsSafe.jsx is 659 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting PIPanel/CapabilityModal into separate files.
In pb/service.get_results, greedy cutline works but 'weighted' branch divides by wsum instead of sum of weights per voter who allocated — acceptable but be aware of semantics.
In pb/service._apply_safe_decision the check `s.get('mode') != 'safe'` correctly skips manual sessions (manual sessions never have `mode` field set) — verified by test.

success_rate.frontend: 50% — /pb modal + toggle works fully; /safe/trains completely broken

Only remaining item is /safe/trains — once FeaturesModal is defined/imported by main agent, retest: (1) expand PI-2 2026 panel, (2) verify pi-feature-row-* rows show 4 features with scope badges + jh/€ totals, (3) click manage-features-btn-686c54ee-b5ec-46c5-98b3-9c63dcacd42b, (4) verify features-modal-body with 2 groups (In PI / Available), (5) toggle a checkbox to assign/unassign and confirm PATCH /api/safe/features/{task_id}/pi is called, (6) click features-modal-close and verify panel list refreshes. Route is /safe/trains (NOT /trains).
rca of the issue: TrainsSafe.jsx line 650 renders <FeaturesModal ...> but grep of the file shows FeaturesModal is only referenced at that one line — not defined as a function/component anywhere in the file, and not imported from any module. React throws 'ReferenceError: FeaturesModal is not defined' during render → error overlay covers the whole page. Reproduction: login as admin@altair.fr, navigate to /safe/trains → runtime error overlay appears. Mitigation: main agent must add the FeaturesModal component (likely was planned but forgotten). Should be a modal listing features grouped by 'assigned to this PI' vs 'available', with checkboxes that call safeAPI.assignFeaturePI(task_id, {pi_id: ...|null}) on toggle.
